verdict.rationale: Portkey's docs have a dedicated automatic-retries page. It retries failed LLM requests with exponential backoff and can optionally honor provider retry-after headers via `use_retry_after_headers`, which directly matches configurable retry policies for transient errors. Supporting resilience features include per-strategy failure handling and status-code customization for fallbacks. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of configurable retry counts and per-status-code retry triggers for retries (status-code targeting is shown only for fallbacks), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
